Scenario Description: Account Management opens Account Settings on Profile
Expected Result: URL /admin/account; heading "Account Settings"; Profile section shown; five section buttons listed.

Scenario Description: Direct URL navigation preserves session
Expected Result: Account Settings renders without login redirect.

Scenario Description: Unauthenticated access is redirected
Expected Result: Redirect to /login; settings never rendered.

Scenario Description: Each section button switches the visible section
Test Steps: 1. Click Profile, Preferences, Security, Billing & Subscriptions, Templates
Expected Result: Section heading updates to the selected section each time.

Scenario Description: Searching "password" surfaces Security
Expected Result: "Found 1 setting across 1 section"; only Security listed; clicking opens Security with Change Password.

Scenario Description: Clearing search restores all sections
Expected Result: All five section buttons visible again.

Scenario Description: Non-matching search hides every section
Expected Result: No section buttons shown; page stays stable.

Scenario Description: Profile shows the logged-in doctor's identity
Expected Result: @<username> and Username field match the logged-in account; Full Name, Email (contains @), Speciality, Qualification, Organization rendered.

Scenario Description: Edit Profile opens pre-populated
Expected Result: First Name non-empty; Email equals the email shown on the Profile card.

Scenario Description: Professional tab fields and speciality list
Test Data: Specialities incl. General Physician, Cardiologist, Psychiatrist, Other
Expected Result: Full Name, Display Name, Qualification (non-empty) and Speciality select with the listed options.

Scenario Description: Empty First Name and invalid Email rejected
Test Steps: 1. Clear First Name; 2. Email not-an-email; 3. Click Save Changes
Expected Result: "Required" and "Invalid email" shown; dialog stays open; zero write requests.

Scenario Description: Cancel discards unsaved changes
Test Steps: 1. Change Last Name; 2. Click Cancel; 3. Reopen dialog
Expected Result: Dialog closes; on reopen the original Last Name is shown; zero write requests.

Scenario Description: Preferences lists search scope and interface toggles
Expected Result: Search Scope, Wave Animation, Print Headers & Footers, Tapering Prescriptions with 4 switches; "Currently: Local/Global" shown.

Scenario Description: Toggling a preference sends a profile update
Expected Result: PUT /users/editProfileData is dispatched (intercepted and blocked — account unchanged).

Scenario Description: Dialog fields masked and submit disabled when empty
Expected Result: Current/New/Confirm inputs are type=password; Change Password submit disabled.

Scenario Description: Mismatched confirmation rejected
Expected Result: "Passwords do not match"; zero write requests.

Scenario Description: Weak new password rejected
Expected Result: Complexity message ("at least 8 characters, one uppercase letter…"); zero write requests.

Scenario Description: Cancel closes dialog and clears entries
Expected Result: Dialog closes; on reopen Current Password is empty.

Scenario Description: Billing shows plan, next billing date and masked card
Expected Result: Current Plan with "Active"; "Next billing: <Month D, YYYY>"; Payment Method with •••• NNNN; no full card number anywhere on page.

Scenario Description: Templates section shows placeholder
Expected Result: "Template management features coming soon".
